title: Feature docs
hint: Turn the session's ticket into the doc tabs below the terminal (Product Requirement, Flows, Technical Design, To Do, Code Review).

actions.label: Read ticket
actions.prompt: Make the feature docs for {ticket}: read the ticket, analyze it, read the related code, and write the tabs.
actions.hint: Reads a ticket (with its parent and sibling stories) and the related code, then writes the feature doc tabs. Links this session to the ticket.

actions.label: Update docs
actions.prompt: Update this session's feature docs: re-read the ticket and the related code, and change only the tabs that need it.
actions.hint: Re-reads the ticket and the code and updates only the doc tabs that changed.
